report_metadata.report_title: MISRA C:2012 Compliance Report - AFE LTC and Maxim Modules

summary.notes: All violations have documented deviations or are suppressed via AXIVION comments

violations.rule_text: The value of an expression should not be cast to an inappropriate essential type
violations.message: Cast from integer to enumeration type MXM_MODEL_ID_e
violations.remediation_hint: Ensure value is validated before cast. Code has AXIVION deviation comment.

violations.rule_text: The value of an expression should not be cast to an inappropriate essential type
violations.message: Cast from integer to enumeration type MXM_SILICON_VERSION_e
violations.remediation_hint: Ensure value is validated before cast. Code has AXIVION deviation comment.

violations.rule_text: The value of an expression should not be cast to an inappropriate essential type
violations.message: Intentional invalid cast to test error handling - explicitly allowed for test functions
violations.remediation_hint: This is intentional test code with AXIVION deviation comment for error path testing.
violations.deviation_reference: AXIVION Next Codeline Style MisraC2012Directive-4.1 MisraC2012-10.5

violations.rule_text: The +, -, += and -= operators should not be applied to an expression of pointer type
violations.message: Pointer arithmetic using increment operator on data pointer in CRC calculation loop
violations.remediation_hint: Consider using array indexing instead of pointer arithmetic. However, this is a common pattern for performance-critical CRC calculations.

violations.rule_text: The value returned by a function having non-void return type shall be used
violations.message: Return value of DIAG_CheckEvent explicitly cast to void
violations.remediation_hint: Explicit (void) cast indicates intentional discard - compliant with MISRA deviation pattern.
violations.deviation_reference: Explicit (void) cast per foxBMS coding standard

violations.rule_text: There should be no unused parameters in functions
violations.message: Parameter spiIndex is explicitly cast to void as function is not implemented
violations.remediation_hint: Parameter is intentionally unused in stub implementation. AXIVION comment documents this.
violations.deviation_reference: AXIVION Routine Generic-MissingParameterAssert: spiIndex: parameter is unused

violations.rule_text: Functions and objects should not be defined with external linkage if they are referenced in only one translation unit
violations.message: Function declared extern but may only be used in one translation unit
violations.remediation_hint: Function is part of public API and extern linkage is intentional. AXIVION comment documents this.
violations.deviation_reference: AXIVION Next Codeline Style MisraC2012-8.7: this function is API of the registry

deviations.justification: Integer-to-enum casts are necessary for parsing register values. All invalid values are filtered before the cast using explicit range checks. This pattern is common in hardware driver code.
deviations.risk_assessment: Low - values are validated before cast

deviations.justification: Intentional use of invalid enum value (42) to test error handling path in self-test function. This is a defensive programming technique to ensure the function correctly rejects invalid input.
Function MXM_MonRegistryGetHighestConnected5XDevice is part of the public API of the registry module and requires external linkage for modularity and testability.

required_rules: Rule 11.1 - Function pointer to void pointer
Rule 11.3 - Pointer to different object type
Rule 11.5 - void pointer to object pointer
advisory_rules: Rule 4.1 - Octal and hex escape sequences

well_implemented_patterns: All functions use FAS_ASSERT for NULL pointer validation
Switch statements have default cases with FAS_ASSERT(FAS_TRAP)
State machines have proper entry state handling
Return values are properly checked or explicitly cast to (void)
AXIVION comments document all intentional deviations
Consistent use of stdint.h types (uint8_t, uint16_t, etc.)
Proper const qualification on pointer parameters
safety_patterns_observed: Error counters with proper overflow protection

iso26262_compliance.asil_support: Supports ASIL A-D for static analysis requirements

recommendations.description: Consider replacing pointer arithmetic in mxm_crc8.c with array indexing for stricter MISRA compliance
Continue maintaining AXIVION deviation comments for traceability

conclusion.summary: The AFE LTC and Maxim driver modules demonstrate high MISRA C:2012 compliance. All mandatory rules pass. Required rule violations have documented deviations with appropriate justifications. Advisory rule observations are minor and reflect common embedded systems patterns. The codebase shows mature safety-oriented coding practices with consistent use of assertions, proper state machine design, and comprehensive error handling.
conclusion.quality_gate_result: PASS - Zero mandatory violations, all required violations have documented deviations
